owner_authorization.context: Owner approved the complete path just described: keep frozen L1, earliest-event dedupe, add a causal global morphology/quality layer, keep LONG and SHORT separate, retain actual-return L2 regression, and validate on unseen data before any use.
approved_bundle: frozen L1 episode reuse with earliest representatives

question: Can a causal side-specific 128-bar quality layer remove locally plausible but globally poor Grade-A L1 proposals, and does a reduced side-specific actual-return L2 add economic ranking value after that filter?

factors: reduced side-specific L2 return ranker off/on
design.purpose: Separate the contribution of global morphology filtering from future-return ranking rather than attributing a bundled result to the wrong layer.

candidate_dataset.note: Frozen pre-holdout L1 episode ledger and TP5/SL2/72 outcomes from the rejected global-context experiment; no L1 rescan or label rebuild.

l1.episode_policy: reuse frozen cross-direction overlap episodes and their earliest model-available representative

l15.label_semantics: Existing Grade-A positive event versus same-symbol/time-block dense-no-launch hard negative. This is a protocol-derived weak label, not a new owner-confirmed global_shape_good label and must not be represented as one.
l15.variant_policy: Train on all 7-8 causal pre/post views but keep every event in one split and evaluate only its earliest available view.
l15.models: one LONG and one SHORT LightGBM binary classifier
l15.final_validation: existing chronological manifest val split beginning after the 2025-12-01 cutoff and its 150-bar purge
l15.threshold_rule: Among tune event-level thresholds with FPR <= 10% and at least 20 true positives, maximize recall, then precision, then threshold.
primary_gate: each side fixed-score label permutation p < 0.01
each side ROC AUC beats the single ma_spread_atr_end model

l2.models: separate LONG and SHORT models in both L2-only and L1.5+L2 arms
l2.reduction_basis: Chosen before this run from causal semantics; removes the 238 per-pixel coordinates and redundant 168-bar features implicated in prior degeneration.
l2.score_gate: 90th percentile of each side's tune scores, frozen before final validation
primary_gate: neither LONG nor SHORT q90 net mean is negative

validation_status.l15_final: chronological event-level final validation not used for threshold selection
validation_status.economic_final: retrospective development only because 2026-04-01..2026-05-03 was consumed by prior L2 configurations
validation_status.fresh_confirmation: required before any acceptance; this run must not read holdout without a new explicit owner approval
